newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank says to inject funds today.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank says to inject funds today.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank will inject funds into the banking system on Saturday through open market operations, a central bank official said.
The bank, through bills finance companies, will execute within-30-day open market operations on qualified securities instruments offered by interested financial institutions, the official said.
Bids will close at 10.30 a.m. (0230GMT). The funds will be released according to actual demand, he said.
